release_notes: Separated the Wallets page into dedicated Wallets and Cards capsule tabs (Wallets first, Cards second) while keeping Total Balance and Quick Add actions accessible above.
Fixed the Android Adaptive Launcher Icon scaling and dark emerald background so the Pockeva wallet emblem displays cleanly across launchers and launch animations.
Locked Wallet Type during editing, separated Add Wallet and Add Card flows, and added persistent long-press drag-and-drop reordering across Wallets, Cards, pickers, and widgets.
Added full confirmation preview dialogs showing exact before and after wallet balances before completing Transfers, Currency Conversions, and Cash Withdrawals.
Applied Noto Serif Bengali typography automatically to Bengali text across the app UI and PDF reports, alongside upgraded navigation bar and tactile button styling.
